name: JK Netori Oni Choukyou ~Gakuen 400-nin no Seishorigakari, Netorare Haramaserareta Seido Iin~
original_name: JK寝取鬼調教 ～学園400人の性処理係、寝取られ孕ませられた性奴委員～
source:
Erina is about to be an exchange student to her fiancé's prestigious boys school for one month. 
However, Erina's fiancé has also decided to be an exchange student to her own school.

While being filled with anxiety, she is protected by her fiancé's older brother, the student council president.
Or so she believes...

In school, she is assigned to the "Sex Slave Committee".
Students, teachers, headmaster, janitors... Anyone can violate Erina, break her heart or turn her into a sex toilet.

While crying out for her fiancé's name, Erina gradually falls into the swamp of pleasure.

[Translated from [url=http://www.parallel-soft.net/poison/jknetori/index.html#Story]Official Site[/url]]
